tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Thank you for joining us today. First, can you tell us why you want to participate in this cultural exchange program?
tasks.analysis: 中文：谢谢您今天参加面试。首先，您能告诉我们您为什么想参加这个文化交流项目吗？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Interesting. Some people say cultural exchange is mostly about learning languages, while others believe it's more about understanding different ways of life.Which view do you agree with more? Why?
tasks.analysis: 中文：有意思。有人说文化交流主要是为了学习语言，而另一些人则认为更重要的是理解不同的生活方式。您更同意哪种观点？为什么？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Great. Now, some believe exchange students should try to blend in completely with local customs, while others think it's okay to keep some of their own traditions. What do you think about this?
tasks.analysis: 中文：很好。现在，有些人认为交换生应该完全融入当地习俗，而另一些人则认为保留一些自己的传统也没关系。您对此怎么看？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Finally, what do you think should university do to help international students get familiar with each other as quick as possible?
tasks.analysis: 中文：最后，您认为大学应该做些什么来帮助国际学生尽快互相熟悉起来？
tasks.title: Interview
